<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Email: by SMTP (any provider, the local Mailpit included) or Resend's API, chosen by MAIL_URL in each environment. Modules send emails from templates of the project; with jobs, each is a job, sealed and retried until it goes. The security blueprint's emails go out here too. With compose, Mailpit catches every email in development, at http://localhost:8025.

```esquadro
blueprint mail
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [env](../env/): the app must use them too.
- **Works with** [jobs](../jobs/), [compose](../compose/), [domain](../domain/), [security](../security/), [testcontainers](../testcontainers/), [docker](../docker/) when the app uses them.

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAIL_URL` | string, secret, required outside development | a value in development | How emails go: smtp://user:password@host:port (TLS on 465, STARTTLS otherwise; without TLS only in development), resend://API_KEY, or log:// (into the log). In development, the local Mailpit of compose.yaml, or the log. |
| `MAIL_SECRET` | string, secret, required outside development | generated in development | With jobs, seals the emails in the queue, links and addresses included; esquadro generates one for development. |
| `MAIL_FROM` | string, required outside development | development: the app's, from its blueprints and options | Who emails come from: Shop &lt;no-reply@shop.com>. |
